title: Progressive Reliable Supervision for Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32474v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Black-Box Universal Domain Adaptation (B$^2$-UniDA) aims to adapt a target model to an unlabeled target domain under arbitrary label-space relationships, while neither source data nor source-model parameters are accessible during adaptation. Under such restrictive information access, reliable target supervision is unavailable, while predictions from the black-box source model can be unreliable due to source bias and domain shifts. To address this challenge, we propose Progressive Reliable Supervision (PReS), which progressively establishes and refines reliable target supervision by coordinating complementary knowledge from the black-box source model, foundation models, and the evolving target model. PReS first identifies reliable known samples by exploiting semantic consistency under diffusion-based perturbations and cross-model consensus between the black-box source model and CLIP. translated_title: 面向黑盒普适域自适应的渐进式可靠监督
translated_abstract: 黑盒普适域自适应（B²-UniDA）旨在将目标模型适配到无标签的目标域，并应对任意的标签空间关系，同时在适配过程中既无法访问源数据，也无法访问源模型参数。在这种受限的信息访问条件下，可靠的目标监督难以获得，而由于源偏差和域偏移的存在，黑盒源模型的预测可能并不可靠。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了渐进式可靠监督（PReS），通过协调来自黑盒源模型、基础模型以及不断演进的目标模型的互补知识，逐步建立并完善可靠的目标监督。PReS首先利用基于扩散的扰动下的语义一致性，以及黑盒源模型与CLIP之间的跨模型共识来识别可靠的已知样本，然后估计样本级的可靠性……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出渐进式可靠监督方法PReS，通过协调黑盒源模型、基础模型（如CLIP）和不断演进的目标模型的互补知识，在无源数据和源模型参数的黑盒普适域自适应场景下，逐步建立并完善可靠的目标监督。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Progressive Reliable Supervision (PReS), which progressively establishes and refines reliable target supervision for black-box universal domain adaptation by coordinating complementary knowledge from the black-box source model, foundation models, and the evolving target model.
